name: Exploded View
tagline: open-wa drawn as an engineered object: a WebGL exploded isometric of the runtime that separates, swaps its browser driver and annotates itself as you scroll, followed by a bill of materials, section views of the code, dimensioned numbers and a title-block footer.
logo: A drafted isometric cube 'o' with redline hidden edges and an extruded isometric 'w'; on hover or focus a faint construction ghost appears and every stroke redraws in order, line by line.
